'''Dirconites''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="Part 2">{{SW|url=news/the-droids-re-animated-part-2|series=The Droids Re-Animated|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref> of rotund [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]]<ref name="Kleb Zellock" /> with [[Color/Legends|light]] skin and small, sharpened [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]<ref name="The Lost Prince" /> that had the ability to produce hypersonic shrieks capable of stunning other humanoids. During the early [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="Kleb Zellock" /> a [[Gender/Legends|male]] Dirconite<ref name="Part 2" /> [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] known as [[Kleb Zellock]] controlled [[Tyne's Horky]]'s criminal underworld.<ref name="Kleb Zellock" />
